name: story-splitting
description: Split oversized user stories using SPIDR (Spike / Path / Interface / Data / Rule) and Richard Lawrence's 9-pattern catalog (workflow steps / business-rule variations / simple-first / variations in data / data-entry methods / defer performance / operations / break-out spikes / major effort). Produces split proposal with rationale per split, post-split INVEST check, value-slicing verification (each sub-story independently valuable), and recommended order. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
